name: FoziScribe
summary: Puts script, voice, music, subtitles, dubbing and YouTube growth tools in one subscription, starting with 10 free credits and plans from 4 € a month.
description: FoziScribe (with FoziQ) is a YouTuber toolkit: 14 creation tools (script, voiceover, music, sound effects, thumbnails, subtitles, dubbing and more) and 13 growth tools, in one plan. Official pricing: start free with 10 credits, no card. Yearly billing is a stated 25% saving on Creator, Growth and Scale. You can cancel anytime.

pricing.details: 10 free credits, no card. Creator 4 €/month or 40 €/year (400 credits, 1 channel); Growth 13 €/month or 120 €/year (2,000 credits, 5 channels); Scale 44 €/month or 393 €/year (9,000 credits, 15 channels); ScaleMax 267 €/month only (60,000 credits). Cancel anytime.
